lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately vertical columns of four to five units, situated posterior to the gill slits and ventral to the primary lateral ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice-like pattern where spots serve as high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal linear feature extending across the mid-flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with specular highlights on the superior edge and distinct shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of high-luminance blobs distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, showing lower geometric regularity than the flank pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, fusiform silhouettes (commensal Echeneidae) swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface below the pectoral fin.
